newsitem.title: CHINA: Rubber Belt to offer bonus shares.
newsitem.headline: Rubber Belt to offer bonus shares.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Rubber Belt Co Ltd have approved a 1.5-for-10 bonus share issue for all shareholders based on the firm's domestically-audited 1996 net profit, the company said in a statement on Friday.
Details of the issue including an ex-rights date will be announced later, the statement said.
The company posted a net profit of 8.2 million yuan for 1996 against 9.99 million yuan for 1995 under domestic accounting standards, the company said in its 1996 annual report issued in April.
But under international accounting standards, the company posted a loss of 5.008 million yuan for 1996 against a profit of 3.554 million yuan for 1995, the annual report said.
